## Introduction

In previous posts I have described how to use the self-contained scripts feature in the *uv* package manager to create [uv virtual environments for the nbstata Jupyter kernel](https://remlapmot.github.io/post/2025/nbstata-uv-venv/) to run Quarto documents with Stata code and to run Quarto documents using the [`jupyter: python3` engine](https://remlapmot.github.io/post/2025/self-contained-python-script-for-quarto/). In this post I describe how to do the same for Quarto documents using the knitr engine (i.e., running R code).

I recently discovered that there are now 3 *uv* inspired package managers for R; *ir*, *uvr*, and *rv*. I will concentrate on the first two as they allow defining self-contained R scripts.






## Summary

I have shown how to make a self-contained executable R script to render Quarto documents using the knitr engine which automatically manage the required R packages.
